title: VBox Sample Metadata
description: Schema for metadata files accompanying .vbox sample inputs in samples/vbox/.

id.description: Unique identifier for this sample, e.g. kali-2024-4-demo-lab-01

kali_version.description: Kali Linux version this VM is based on, e.g. 2024.4

vbox_filename.description: Name of the .vbox file in samples/vbox/ (filename only, no path)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this sample was created

description.description: Human-readable description of the VM's purpose and configuration

vbox_version.description: VirtualBox version this VM was created with

os_variant.description: Guest OS identifier as reported by VirtualBox

memory_mb.description: RAM allocated to the VM in megabytes

disk_size_gb.description: Total virtual disk size in gigabytes

host_only_interface.description: Name of the host-only interface, e.g. vboxnet0

installed_tools.description: Notable tools pre-installed beyond the default Kali toolset

notes.description: Free-form notes about this sample (credentials, caveats, demo steps)

examples.description: Kali 2024.4 lab VM with kalitorify and theHarvester pre-configured for OSINT demos.
examples.notes: Default credentials: kali / kali. Change immediately.
